{{Quote|To hold awareness longer that that and to appear to others in the physical world while retaining both visual and auditory aspects&mdash;is a remarkable feat, if true. I have read that the Lorekeepers of the Whills have perfected this, but the Whills remain a frustrating puzzle for those who wish to learn more about them.|Darth Plagueis, in the ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''Lorekeepers of the Whills''' where an organization that was associated with the [[Ancient Order of the Whills|Whills]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] had read that the [[Lorekeeper]]s had mastered the ability to [[Immortality/Legends|appear to others in the physical realm after death]] while being able to see and hear. Plagueis wrote his findings, as well as that knoweldge of the Whills was difficult to uncover for those who wished it, in the book ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="Book of Sith" />
